title: The Unquiet Ledger
author: Jude Crane
blurb: Orsen Brightwater, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
